request.style: English, slow minor-key blues, aching soulful male vocal, clean electric blues guitar, Hammond organ, upright bass, brushed drums, heavy-hearted, 66 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
I told him even if they all fall away, Lord, I never will
Even if I must die with you, I'd be standing with you still
He looked at me and told me what this very night would bring
Before the rooster crows, you will deny me three times

[Verse]
They led him to the high priest's house, I followed far behind
They kindled a fire in the courtyard and I sat down in the light
A servant girl looked close at me and said this man was with him too
I said woman, I don't know him, and I didn't know what to do

[Chorus]
Before the rooster crows
Before the rooster crows
You will deny me three times
And he went outside and wept bitterly

[Verse]
A little later someone said, you are one of them too
I said man, I am not, I don't know what you're talking to
An hour later, your accent gives you away, they swore
And I began to curse and swear, I do not know the man, no more

[Chorus]
Before the rooster crows
Before the rooster crows
You will deny me three times
And he went outside and wept bitterly

[Bridge]
At that very moment, while he was still speaking, the rooster crowed
The Lord turned and looked straight at Peter
And Peter remembered the word the Lord had spoken
Three times I said I never knew him
The one who knew me best of all

[Outro]
He went outside and wept bitterly
Before the rooster crows
